items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I can hear of ... Coleman Hawkins ... who was with me in Europe. He's gone, too.

ctx.x: And they used to open it out on the street, too, at one time, anyway.
Yeah, right. And I was in and out of the Metropole, one time I was there with Coleman Hawkins, Roy Eldridge and different, different -- (Recording interruption)
